description: Adversarial export cases. Each mutates an otherwise-valid screened bundle and must be REFUSED for the stated reason. A validator whose refusals nobody has watched is indistinguishable from one that always returns ok.

cases.name: run_kind_private_dogfood
cases.why: A dogfood trace is never eligible for publication, full stop.

cases.name: run_kind_calibration
cases.why: Calibration includes a private calibration cohort — read to validate, never counted.

cases.name: run_kind_disagreement
cases.why: A manifest relabelled to look exportable while the run record says otherwise.

cases.name: raw_source_ref_left_in
cases.why: Carries local paths and hashes of private content; screening strips it entirely.

cases.name: args_digest_left_in
cases.why: Screening drops it unless the underlying args are already public.

cases.name: raw_message_text

user_message.content: please fix the login bug in acme-corp

cases.why: Message text must never reach a public artifact regardless of source.

cases.name: thinking_content_smuggled
cases.why: Thinking content is never part of a public artifact.

cases.name: home_path_in_unexpected_field
cases.why: The structural check cannot know every field; the scan reads the serialized bundle.

cases.name: windows_home_path
cases.why: Same leak on a different platform.

cases.name: email_address
cases.why: Personal identifiers are not evidence.

cases.name: anthropic_key
cases.why: Credential shapes must halt an export.

cases.name: github_token
cases.why: Credential shapes must halt an export.

cases.name: aws_key
cases.why: Credential shapes must halt an export.

cases.name: bearer_token
cases.why: Credential shapes must halt an export.

cases.name: private_key_block
cases.why: Credential shapes must halt an export.

cases.name: manifest_missing_field
cases.expect_reason_contains: required field missing or empty: pinned_commit
cases.why: A malformed manifest is not provenance; public evidence needs its anchor.

cases.name: manifest_event_count_mismatch
cases.why: A manifest that miscounts its own run cannot vouch for it.

cases.name: unreconciled_run
cases.why: Unreconciled data is exactly what the adapter-reconciliation incident produced.

cases.name: no_signoff
cases.why: The manual step is required, not advisory.

cases.name: incomplete_checklist
cases.why: A half-completed checklist is not a sign-off.

cases.name: checklist_with_invented_item
cases.why: The checklist is fixed; it is not extended at export time to make a run pass.

cases.name: placeholder_pinned_commit
cases.expect_reason_contains: is not a git commit hash
cases.why: Dogfood ingestion writes 'unknown'; a non-empty placeholder must not pass as provenance.

cases.name: local_private_repo_url
cases.why: A local repository cannot back a public artifact, however the manifest labels it.

cases.name: field_status_advertising_dropped_field
cases.why: Found by running against a real session: screening kept field_status verbatim, so it named fields it had just dropped.

cases.name: continuity_annotation_embedded
cases.why: A compaction-continuity annotation is Tier 1 terminal: it records a human's reading of protected transcript context, so it has no screened form and is refused structurally rather than redacted.
